title: Audi Trainee Sales Executive
description:
About the role

A fantastic opportunity is available for a Trainee Sales Executive to join our team at Reading Audi.

As a Sytner Trainee Sales Executive, you will be the first point of contact for customers by initiating conversation and building rapport to excite them about the brand. You will promote the benefits and unique selling points of Audi, accessories and vehicle ownership.

This is a full-time role which can typically include weekends to ensure we provide our customers with the highest possible levels of service.

About you

Ideally, you will have previous experience of working in retail and be able to maintain exceptional customer care in a competitive environment.

A passion for delivering excellent customer service is a key attribute of the position, along with a determination to expand your knowledge and inspire others; you will demonstrate enthusiasm and self-motivation to excel in customer service. We offer extensive training to allow you to develop expert knowledge of the Audi.

This role is a fantastic opportunity for those who enjoy meeting people and working for a prestige brand in a highly successful and motivated team.

A full and valid UK driving license would be beneficial / preferred.

When applying for this role please consider that we require candidates to have obtained GCSE grade A -C/9-4 or Functional Skills Level 2 (or equivalent) in the following subjects, English, Maths and 1 other subject as a threshold level of qualification.

Why Sytner?

Sytner Group are delighted to provide an industry-leading benefits package.

We are passionate about continuous improvement and building an environment where everyone feels valued, appreciated and able to reach their full potential.
- Enhanced Holiday Entitlement 33 days inc. bank holidays
- Industry-leading Maternity, Paternity and Adoption Pay
- Career Development
- Recognition of Long Service every 5 years
- Discounted Car Schemes
- High Street Discounts
- Discounted Gym memberships
- Cycle to work scheme
- One day a year paid voluntary / community work

At Sytner, our values and the way we behave are important to us. We are committed to creating an equitable working environment where we value and respect every individual's unique contribution, supporting our colleagues to thrive and achieve their full potential.

As part of our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion, you have the right to ask for changes / adjustments to job interviews and the recruitment process. For more information around reasonable adjustments and the recruitment process please click here.

Unsure? Read on

title: Freight Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive - Freight Forwarding

Location: Crowthorne, Berkshire
Salary: Up to 35,000
Hours: Monday - Friday, 09:00 - 17:30
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

An established international freight forwarding business is looking to recruit an Internal Sales Executive to join its team in Crowthorne.

This is a great opportunity for someone with previous freight forwarding sales experience who enjoys pricing, customer interaction and securing new business opportunities across Air, Sea and Road Freight.

The Role

Working closely with customers, overseas partners, carriers and the operations team, you will be responsible for producing competitive freight quotations and following opportunities through from initial enquiry to shipment handover.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Preparing competitive and accurate pricing for bids, tenders and general quotations across Air, Sea and Road Freight
- Generating quotations through CargoWise
- Liaising with airlines and shipping lines to obtain competitive rates
- Following up quotations and developing opportunities with customers
- Liaising with UK customers and overseas partners/agents
- Handling customer and pricing-related queries
- Passing successfully secured shipments across to the operations team with clear instructions Internal sales role JD (2)

The Candidate

You will ideally have:
- A minimum of 2 years sales experience within freight forwarding
- A good understanding of the freight forwarding industry
- Strong customer service and negotiation skills
- Excellent verbal, written and telephone communication
- The ability to provide accurate quotations across Air, Sea and Road Freight
- Good numerical ability and attention to detail
- Experience using Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook
- The ability to work effectively in a busy, competitive environment
- A professional, positive attitude and willingness to learn and develop

WR Logistics are a leading recruitment partner for the logistics and supply chain industry, recruiting across the UK, Europe, and the USA for permanent opportunities.

WR Logistics is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy

title: New Business Sales Executive IT Solutions & Consulting
description:
Job Title: New Business Sales Executive - IT Solutions & Consulting

Location: Reading (Hybrid)

Salary: £50,000 - £60,000 Base Salary + Uncapped OTE & Benefits

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

About the Opportunity

Thames 360 Limited is delighted to be partnering with a global leader in IT Service Management (ITSM), consulting, and professional training solutions to find their next high-calibre sales professional.

Our client has a rich history of pioneering industry frameworks and a reputation for excellence, helping enterprise businesses transform their corporate operations and technology environments. We are working closely with them to expand their Reading-based commercial team and are looking for a New Business Sales Executive to drive revenue growth.

The Role

As a New Business Sales Executive, you will focus on hunting and securing new enterprise accounts across the UK and EMEA markets, while strategically capitalising on warm inbound leads. This is a hybrid position that perfectly balances consultative phone/virtual engagement with face-to-face client pitches.

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline Generation: Proactively identify, map, and target new business opportunities within mid-market and enterprise corporate accounts.

Consultative Selling: Understand complex client challenges and position our client's bespoke IT training, frameworks, and consulting services as the definitive solution.

End-to-End Sales Management: Manage the entire sales cycle from initial cold/warm outreach and discovery calls to leading high-impact presentations and closing the deal.

Collaboration: Work closely with our client's technical consultants and delivery teams to ensure tailored solutions meet exact requirements.

What Our Client Is Looking For

Proven B2 B Sales Track Record: A minimum of 3+ years of successful business-to-business sales experience, ideally within IT services, SaaS, consulting, or professional corporate training.

Framework Knowledge: Familiarity with modern operational frameworks (such as ITIL, SIAM, or general ITSM) is highly advantageous, though not strictly mandatory.

Strong Communicator: An exceptional relationship builder with a consultative, listener-first approach to sales who can confidently pitch to C-suite decision-makers.

Driven Mindset: A self-motivated "hunter" mentality with a passion for smashing targets and maximizing uncapped commission structures.

What's on Offer

Competitive base salary up to £60,000 (dependent on experience).

Generous, transparent, and uncapped commission structure.

Hybrid working model based out of modern offices in Reading.

Clear internal progression pathways and comprehensive solution training.

Corporate benefits package, including pension and wellness perks.

To Apply: Please submit your CV to the team at Thames 360 Limited today for immediate consideration.

title: Sales Consultant
description:
Job Advert: New Homes Sales Consultant (Shared Ownership Experience)
Location: West London , Berkshire ; Hampshire

Salary: £ 37881 to £39,874
Job Type: FTC 12 Months

Are you an experienced sales consultant with a passion for helping people secure their dream homes? We are seeking a dynamic and motivated New Homes Sales Consultant with some experience in Selling Shared Ownership developments to join our vibrant team. The Sales Consultant is a front-line representative of So Resi and MTVH and has responsibility for the delivery of the sales budget, working in multiple locations across a broad geographic area. You will be responsible for contributing to the sales delivery and performance across the region, with a focus on ensuring an excellent customer experience is delivered as well as health and safety requirements are upheld. You will be responsible for delivering the customer journey from Sales Launch, lead management, application processing through to completion. You will be required to efficiently engage with all key internal and external stakeholders throughout the sales process. Tuesday to Saturday is required.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage the sales process for new homes, from initial inquiry to the completion of the sale.
- Provide expert advice on shared ownership properties, ensuring clients fully understand the benefits and process.
- Deliver exceptional customer service, guiding clients through every step of the purchasing journey.
- Develop strong relationships with buyers, mortgage brokers, and other stakeholders to facilitate smooth transactions.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of client interactions, sales progress, and pipeline management.
- Organize and host property viewings, ensuring a professional and informative experience for potential buyers.
- Meet and exceed sales targets while adhering to company policies and procedures.

Essential Requirements:
- Proven experience in new homes sales, particularly with Affordable housing schemes.
- Strong understanding of the shared ownership process and eligibility criteria.
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
- Target-driven with the ability to work in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.
- A professional and approachable manner, with a passion for delivering outstanding customer service.
- A valid driving license and access to your own vehicle

Desirable:
- Previous experience in a similar role within a housing developer or sales agency.
- Knowledge of the local housing market and available schemes.

What We Offer:
- Competitive salary with an attractive commission structure.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.
- A supportive and collaborative team environment.
- Opportunities for career progression within a leading property developer.

If you're ready to take your career in property sales to the next level, apply today and become part of our forward-thinking team.

Metropolitan Thames Valley Housing (MTVH) provides affordable homes for people living across London, the South East, the East Midlands and the East of England.

Alongside housing, MTVH delivers a range of support services, working with residents who need additional help to live independently and well. This includes specialist support for older people, mental health services and transitional services that provide intensive support to people who are marginalised or vulnerable.

MTVH is committed to building strong, thriving communities. Through training programmes, events and activities, the organisation supports residents to improve employability, build skills and access opportunities that make a meaningful difference to their lives.

In line with the MTVH 2030 strategy ? Your Home, Your Service, Your Future ? diversity, equity and inclusion are central to how MTVH works. A range of colleague networks support gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation and disability, helping to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging.

These networks provide a platform for colleagues to share their views, recognise what is working well and influence improvements. By listening, learning, and working together, MTVH continues to strengthen its culture, tackle business challenges and ensure it is serving people better every day.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Sales Development Representative

The Role

We are looking for a driven and commercially minded Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join a growing financial services business specialising in solutions for the UK recruitment sector.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys speaking to businesses, building relationships and generating new opportunities, with a clear route to developing a long-term career within business development and sales.

You will be responsible for identifying prospective recruitment businesses, engaging with decision-makers, understanding their requirements and qualifying opportunities before handing them across to the wider commercial team.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and research prospective recruitment agencies and businesses.
- Proactively contact potential clients through phone, email and LinkedIn.
- Speak with business owners, directors and senior decision-makers.
- Introduce the company's finance and business solutions and understand their requirements.
- Qualify inbound and outbound opportunities against agreed criteria.
- Build relationships with prospects and create genuine interest in the proposition.
- Book qualified meetings and opportunities for the Business Development team.
- Maintain accurate prospect and pipeline information within the CRM.
- Follow up consistently with prospective clients to develop opportunities.
- Work closely with the wider sales and account management teams to maximise conversion.
- Develop a strong understanding of the recruitment finance / invoice finance market and the challenges recruitment businesses face.
- Contribute to outbound campaigns and initiatives designed to generate new business.
- Consistently work towards agreed activity, meeting and opportunity targets.

The Ideal Candidate

We're looking for someone who is confident, personable and commercially driven, with the resilience and enthusiasm to pick up the phone and speak to new businesses.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience in SDR, BDE, telesales, recruitment, business development or a similar outbound sales role.
- Strong telephone and communication skills.
- The confidence to speak with business owners and senior decision-makers.
- A genuine interest in sales and relationship building.
- A proactive and persistent approach to generating new opportunities.
- Strong organisation and CRM/pipeline management skills.
- The ability to ask good questions and understand a prospect's business needs.
- Commercial awareness and a desire to learn about recruitment finance, invoice finance and working capital solutions.
- A target-driven mindset without being overly transactional in your approach.

Experience within recruitment finance, invoice finance, commercial finance or working with recruitment agencies would be highly advantageous, but is not essential.

The Opportunity

This is a great opportunity for an ambitious salesperson looking to join a growing business and develop within B2 B financial services.

You will receive exposure to recruitment businesses, finance and working capital solutions, while working alongside an experienced commercial team.

For the right person, there is a clear opportunity to progress from SDR into a Business Development / Account Management position as your experience and understanding of the market develops.

If you're competitive, personable, commercially curious and enjoy opening doors and building relationships, this could be an excellent next step.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive

Location: Maidenhead
Salary: 32,000pa + Commission

The Role

We're working with a growing business looking to recruit a motivated and commercially minded Sales Executive to join its team in Windsor.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, identifying new business opportunities and working in a varied, customer-facing role. You'll be involved in developing new customer relationships, supporting existing accounts and contributing to wider business growth.

The role also offers the opportunity to gain exposure to exhibitions, trade shows and international business events, providing valuable experience in networking, developing commercial contacts and representing the business professionally.

Working closely with the wider sales team, you'll support business development activities, engage with prospective customers and help manage opportunities throughout the sales process. You'll also have the opportunity to attend exhibitions and international events, helping to build connections and identify potential new business.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Researching prospective customers and identifying new business opportunities.
- Generating leads and supporting new business development activities.
- Contacting potential customers by telephone, email and LinkedIn.
- Building and maintaining relationships with prospective and existing customers.
- Responding to customer enquiries promptly and professionally.
- Preparing quotations, presentations and other sales-related documentation.
- Following up on enquiries, quotations and potential opportunities to help generate new business.
- Coordinating customer requests and liaising with internal colleagues to ensure information is accurate.
- Maintaining accurate customer records and keeping sales information up to date.
- Assisting with sales reports and monitoring the progress of opportunities.
- Attending exhibitions, trade shows and international business events to represent the business, develop contacts and explore new opportunities.
- Supporting customer meetings, networking activities and follow-up communications following events.
- Assisting with order coordination and keeping customers informed of progress.
- Developing product knowledge and an understanding of the wider market.
- Providing general administrative support to the sales team when required.

About You

We're looking for someone who is proactive, organised and confident communicating with people. You'll enjoy developing relationships, exploring new opportunities and working towards shared commercial goals.

You'll ideally have:
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- A confident and professional telephone and email manner.
- The ability to build rapport and develop positive business relationships.
- A proactive approach to identifying opportunities and following up with customers.
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise effectively.
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
- Confidence using LinkedIn or other platforms to research and contact prospective customers.
- The ability to work independently while contributing to a wider team.
- A willingness to attend exhibitions, trade shows and business events when required.

Experience and Qualifications

Previous experience in sales, business development, customer service, administration or another customer-facing role would be beneficial.

Experience using CRM systems, researching potential customers or supporting sales pipelines would be an advantage.

A qualification in business, marketing or a related subject would also be welcomed, although practical experience, enthusiasm and the right attitude are equally important.

Personal Attributes

The successful candidate will be:
- Friendly, approachable and professional.
- Self-motivated with a genuine interest in sales and business development.
- Confident initiating conversations and following up with potential customers.
- Organised, reliable and detail-oriented.
- Comfortable networking and meeting new people.
- Adaptable and willing to learn.
- Keen to develop commercially and build a long-term career in sales.

Interested?

If you're a confident communicator with a proactive attitude and an interest in developing a career in sales, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Technical Presales Consultant
description:
Getting a technical solution right from the start can make all the difference between a project that runs smoothly and one that runs into problems. As a Technical Presales Consultant, you'll have the opportunity to shape complex data centre projects, win customer confidence and take ownership of delivery from initial discussions through to final handover.

This is a genuinely varied position, split approximately 50/50 between technical pre-sales and project delivery. You'll work directly with customers to understand their requirements, develop practical solutions and ensure projects are delivered successfully.

You'll be joining a specialist physical IT infrastructure services business, working closely with an established five-person team and reporting directly to the COO.

What's in it for you
- £70,000 - £80,000 basic salary, depending on experience.
- Additional earning potential through a bonus/commission scheme.
- Hybrid working arrangements, with regular office attendance in Bracknell and travel to customer sites across the UK.
- A varied role combining technical pre-sales, customer engagement and hands-on project delivery.
- Direct access to the COO, with the opportunity to influence how projects are scoped, priced and delivered.
- Exposure to a wide range of physical IT infrastructure projects, including data centre relocations, hardware installations, structured cabling and decommissioning.

Your responsibilities as Technical Presales Consultant
- Work alongside the sales team to understand customer requirements, conduct site surveys and identify practical technical solutions.
- Develop accurate estimates, scopes of work and technical proposals that support successful bids and customer commitments.
- Manage infrastructure projects from initial planning through to completion, maintaining control of budgets, resources and delivery schedules.
- Coordinate engineers, suppliers and subcontractors to ensure installations, relocations and decommissioning projects are delivered successfully.
- Identify technical and operational risks early, maintaining clear customer communication throughout the project lifecycle.
- Share your pre-sales knowledge with colleagues, supporting their development in customer discovery, technical scoping and estimating.

What we're looking for in a Technical Presales Consultant
- Demonstrable technical pre-sales experience, including customer discovery, solution design, scoping, estimating and supporting successful bids.
- Strong practical knowledge of physical IT infrastructure within live data centre environments, including rack-and-stack, cabling and hardware installations.
- Experience independently managing technical infrastructure projects, including budgets, resources, suppliers and delivery risks.
- Background within an IT infrastructure services provider, systems integrator, technology vendor or a similar technical environment.
- Experience working directly with customers, translating technical requirements into commercially viable proposals and deliverable project plans.

Working hours: Full-time, with hybrid working, regular attendance at the Bracknell office and travel to customer sites across the UK. Specific working hours to be confirmed.

If you've built your career around physical IT infrastructure and enjoy both winning technical projects and seeing them delivered successfully, this could be the ideal next step. Apply today to find out more about this Technical Presales Consultant opportunity.
